1. **libLSE:** the engine as an in-process library behind a plain C API ([`include/lse/lse.h`](https://github.com/Geramy/LSE/blob/v0.5.0/include/lse/lse.h)); `lse-server` is a thin command line over it.
2. **iPadOS:** Qwen3.8-27B Q4 with the Q8 DFlash2 draft on an R9700 over Thunderbolt on an iPad Pro (M4), through mac_linuxgpu's embedded driver and `LSE.xcframework`: **40.5 tok/s** warm decode at 73% acceptance (the M5 Max Mac measured 43.3 tok/s at 74% with v0.4.24), **57–70 tok/s** at 85–93%, about 34 s model load, **0** CPU fallbacks.
3. **DFlash2 BF16 checkpoints load directly:** converted once to Q8/group64, bit-identical to the reference script, and cached.
4. **Model info and memory estimates:** `--model-info` and `--estimate` (and `lse_model_info`/`lse_estimate`) describe a checkpoint and size a configuration from its headers, with no device; weights and KV match a real load to within 0.001%.
